assertions.assertion: Explains the BFF removes the Cookie header after YARP copies headers and after the route's configured transforms run, so a route transform that sets Cookie has no effect while removal is on
assertions.rationale: Says BFF removes Cookie after/outside normal transforms so the transform is overwritten.

assertions.assertion: Notes transforms/transform providers registered after AddBffExtensions (e.g. AddTransforms on the returned IReverseProxyBuilder) run later and can set a specific Cookie
assertions.rationale: Suggests alternate header or middleware, not transforms registered after AddBffExtensions.

assertions.assertion: Warns not to copy the browser's cookies back onto the request
assertions.rationale: No warning against copying browser cookies back.
